bodies.summary: An air world of class F, 3,230 million miles from the Sun, with a diameter of 27,589 miles.

bodies.name: Charon
bodies.summary: A class E world, 7,105 million miles from the Sun. It is the farthest planet in the home system, with a diameter of 5,320 miles.

bodies.name: Crown Rock
bodies.summary: A desolate asteroid with almost no food or water and a raised outcrop in the shape of a crown. The neogi Raver, a pirate, left mutinous crew members here.
facts: Desolate, with almost no food or water
A raised outcrop called the crown
Raver, a neogi pirate, marooned mutinous crew here
Not given in the books. The map estimates 180 million miles from the Sun.

bodies.name: The Three Sisters
bodies.summary: A brightly lit asteroid with a tavern for pirates and other spacefarers. The tavern is in a cave, and a lit and signed cave mouth leads to it.
facts: A tavern in a cave for pirates and other spacefarers
Raver, a neogi pirate, stopped here for supplies
Not given in the books. The map estimates 330 million miles from the Sun.

bodies.name: Big Rock
bodies.summary: An asteroid that a band of pirates, led by the neogi Raver, used as a trap. Raver set the trap for Captain Blotomus, who chased him.
facts: Pirates led by the neogi Raver set a trap here
Not given in the books. The map estimates 420 million miles from the Sun.

spheres.name: Aebrynisspace
spheres.summary: The sphere of Aebrynis, the world of the Birthright setting. Spacefarers think of it as a backwater.

spheres.name: Pyrespace
spheres.summary: The system of the Pyre, the setting of Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon. The book lists eight worlds: the Pyre, four inner planets, the Spider Moon, the Chain of Tears, and Moradin's Forge. Elves, humans, dwarves, gnomes, drow, and mind flayers live there.
facts: 5: Ashen, Verdura, Quelya, Perianth, and Moradin's Forge
The Chain of Tears, outside Perianth's orbit
A major helm crosses between adjacent planets in 1d6+1 days, and a minor helm in 2d6+2 days
Beyond the Chain of Tears: comets, meteor showers, and bitter cold

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: The Pyre
bodies.summary: The fire body at the center of the system. It gives heat and light to the inner worlds. Some say it is a gate to the Elemental Plane of Fire.
facts: Fire body, the primary of the system
Almost all elemental fire, with toxic smoke and a few rocky earthbergs
Fire damage each round, smoke that limits sight to 120 feet, steam clouds, and ash rain
Salamanders, mephits, and dragons on the earthbergs. The efreet reportedly keep an outpost.
Almost none. Some earthbergs hold gems or metals.

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: Ashen
bodies.summary: The planet closest to the Pyre. It is a hot desert of white dust with half-buried ruins. Treasure seekers come for the magic hidden in the sand.
facts: Desert planet, first from the Pyre
Days average 120 degrees F and reach 150. Nights fall as low as 60.
Pyramids and obelisks of a culture that died long ago
Buried towers in the southern hemisphere, in a region of harsh dust storms
Dust mephits, jann, blue and copper dragons, ghouls, and sand purple worms

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: Verdura
bodies.summary: The first habitable planet from the Pyre, covered by tropical jungle. Reptiles and dinosaurs roam it. The fallen yuan-ti empire rules small areas among ruined temples.
facts: Jungle planet, second from the Pyre
About two thirds land, with a few shallow seas and many lakes
80 to 100 degrees F by day, and 70 or more at night
The Temple of the Feathered Serpent, a ziggurat on an island in a swamp lake

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: Quelya
bodies.summary: The third planet from the Pyre and the home of humans. Ocean covers more than 90% of it, with long chains of islands. Humans and halflings live on the islands, and sahuagin live in the sea.
facts: Water planet, third from the Pyre
None, so the tides are almost nil
Humans and halflings on the islands, and sahuagin under the sea
Lagos, a merchant freehold that can pack up in a few hours

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: Perianth
bodies.summary: The fourth planet from the Pyre and the last inner planet. Old forests cover it. Elves rule it, and noble houses scheme for power. The Spider Moon orbits it.
facts: Forest planet, fourth from the Pyre
Lakes and small seas cover up to 30% of the surface
Cool autumn weather. Days reach 50 to 70 degrees F, and nights fall to the 30s or 40s.
Elves rule. Fey creatures, treants, and green dragons also live here.
At least 12 elven fiefdoms, including the Duchy of Fleuris

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: The Spider Moon
bodies.summary: The moon of Perianth, where the elves exiled the drow long ago. It is a cold, rough world with thin thickets and many caves.
facts: Cold winds, rough peaks, and crags
Large cave networks run under the surface
Drow rule. Ogres, ettins, hill giants, and many spiders also live here.
Xogotha, a drow city in a great cavern

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: The Chain of Tears
bodies.summary: An asteroid belt that separates the inner worlds from the cold outer zone. People say a planet once filled its place. Gnomes, pirates, and formians live among its rocks.
facts: People say it is what remains of a planet, the home of the gnomes
Minerals, salvage, and the trade of Discord

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: Discord
bodies.summary: One of the larger asteroids in the Chain of Tears. The city of Discord fills it above and below the surface. Anything is for sale there, and it has a black market.
facts: Weapons, ships, food, and magic. Black marketers sell poison and slaves.
Scoundrels, spacehands, and fortune hunters of every kind
Tight quarters above and below the surface
Humans born here still call Quelya their homeworld

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

bodies.name: Moradin's Forge
bodies.summary: The cold planet beyond the Chain of Tears and the home world of the dwarves. Mind flayers now rule it. Warm tunnels under the broken surface hold most of its life.
facts: Cold mountain planet, the fifth and last planet
Mid 30s degrees F in summer, and as low as minus 20 on winter nights
Craggy mountains, cratered chasms, and thick polar caps
Dwarves and orcs, under mind flayers with grimlock armies
Volcanic vents heat the caves and tunnels
Copper, iron, gold, silver, mithral, adamantine, and gems
Veil, a secret dwarf town that resists the mind flayers

sources.title: Polyhedron #151, "Spelljammer: Shadow of the Spider Moon"

spheres.name: Doomspace
spheres.summary: The sun of this wildspace system collapsed into a black vortex, the Eye of Doom. Each orbit brings two worlds and twelve moons closer to it. Shards of the broken crystal sphere fill the outer edge.
facts: The Eye of Doom, a black vortex
Gray crystal shards, each 1 mile thick and hundreds of miles long
Not known for fact. Some say angry gods collapsed the sun.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Eye of Doom
bodies.summary: The remains of the sun of Doomspace, a dark vortex that gives no light. It pulls the planets, moons and crystal shards of the system closer with each orbit. The book does not say what happens to a creature that enters it.
facts: Dark vortex, the remains of the sun
None of its own. Dim light shows at its edge.
Each orbit brings the planets, moons and shards closer.
The book does not decide. It can be a gate to another dimension, reality or system.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Valt
bodies.summary: A moon that the Eye of Doom pulled out of the orbit of Fyreen. It now orbits the vortex, closer to it than any other body. It falls into the vortex within days.
facts: Distance from the Eye of Doom
It was a moon of Fyreen until the Eye pulled it free.
It is only days from falling into the vortex.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Fyreen
bodies.summary: A volcanic world that dragons stripped of its wealth. Tyrants fight over the resources that remain. Heat from inside the world keeps it from freezing now that the sun is gone.
facts: Distance from the Eye of Doom
1 moon, Crios. Its other moon, Valt, is gone.
The temperature fell fast when the sun collapsed. Heat from the planet keeps it from freezing.
Dohwars and mercanes moved thousands of creatures away. Millions stayed behind.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Crios
bodies.summary: The smaller of the two moons of Fyreen. It still orbits the planet. The Eye of Doom will pull it away in about a month, as it did Valt.
facts: Moon of Fyreen (the smaller of two)
The Eye of Doom will pull it away in about a month.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Malas
bodies.summary: A water world that ice now covers. Its surface has sheer-sided mountains and deep canyons. A moon-sized spindle of ice orbits it.
facts: Distance from the Eye of Doom
1 moon, a spindle of smooth ice
Ice over the whole world, with sheer-sided mountains and deep canyons

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Spindle of Ice
bodies.summary: A moon-sized spindle of smooth ice that orbits Malas. Some believe it is a shard of the planet. A nation of yeti lives on it.
facts: Believed to be a shard of Malas
A nation of yeti who are highly intelligent and fear outsiders, and other beings

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Aruun
bodies.summary: A large moon of En, the biggest of the nine by the map key. Tarrasques roam its wastes of rock pillars. Aartuks and smaller creatures live in forests on top of the plateaus.
facts: Spherical earth body, one of the nine moons of En
Distance from the Eye of Doom
A wasteland of rock pillars with lightning between them. Jungle covers some plateaus.
Tarrasques on the ground. Aartuks and smaller creatures on the plateaus.
The map key and chapter 7 call it the largest of the nine.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: G'vek
bodies.summary: A moon of En with sheer mountains. Aarakocra families from Fyreen live in the mountains. B'rohgs, death dogs and other monsters hunt in the foothills.
facts: Moon of En with sheer mountains
One of the nine moons of En
B'rohgs, death dogs, gorgons, hydras and others in the foothills

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Inivar
bodies.summary: A ball of gas in many colors that swirls. A bright, flickering light shines from its core and works as a beacon.
facts: Ball of gas in many colors
One of the nine moons of En
A bright, flickering light shines from the core
It works as a beacon in the dark system

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Lesk
bodies.summary: A dark desert moon of En. The text calls it the largest of the nine. Clans of ssurran live there in harsh conditions.
facts: One of the nine moons of En
The text calls it the largest. The map key says that Aruun is the largest.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Shalar
bodies.summary: An ice moon of En with a ring of ice crystals around its equator. Humans from Fyreen built large camps on the polar ice. Dinosaurs roam the frozen land.
facts: One of the nine moons of En
A ring of ice crystals lies around the equator
Human camps on the polar ice caps. Dinosaurs eat the sparse plants and each other.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Ring of Shalar
bodies.summary: A ring of ice crystals around the equator of Shalar.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Thrydd
bodies.summary: A giant ball of ice cut by deep canyons. Thermal vents heat the canyons. Many monsters live in them.
facts: One of the nine moons of En
Deep canyons cross the surface. Thermal vents heat them.
Braxats, gaj, megapedes, remorhazes, ssurran and thri-kreen

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Vocath
bodies.summary: A moon made entirely of toxic green gas. The mercane Vocath gave it his own name. His base floats above its glowing clouds.
facts: One of the nine moons of En
Vocath's Base floats above the clouds
300 million miles at the start of the adventure (3 days of travel)

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Vocath's Base
bodies.summary: A base of gray and black stone that floats above the green clouds of the moon Vocath. Crystal formations stick out from its underside. The mercane Vocath runs a gladiator arena here.
facts: Floating base of stone with a crystal dome and docks
A gladiator arena, docks for ships and a private tower

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Yisheen
bodies.summary: A small, barren moon of En covered with black frost. It belongs to Yisheen, a miserly adult lunar dragon who refuses all solicitors.
facts: Small, barren moon covered with black frost
One of the nine moons of En
Yisheen, a miserly adult lunar dragon

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Yort
bodies.summary: A cold, swampy moon of En. Petrified skeletons of kindori lie across its surface. Humanoids from Fyreen built shelters among the bones.
facts: One of the nine moons of En
Petrified skeletons of kindori cover the ground
Humanoids who left Fyreen live in shelters among the bones

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Shattered Sphere
bodies.summary: Smoky gray crystal shards, each 1 mile thick and hundreds of miles long. They are what remains of the crystal sphere around the system. They float in the outermost region.
facts: Each shard is 1 mile thick and hundreds of miles long
The outermost region. A ship needs about 3 days to cross it.
Nothing known can chip or break the crystal
The primordials built the sphere to keep the gods out. How it broke is not known.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

spheres.name: Xaryxispace
spheres.summary: The home system of the Xaryxian Empire of astral elves. It holds the white star Xaryxis, three planets and the floating Imperial Citadel. The star is dim, so the elves drain other worlds to refill it.
facts: 3 planets, 1 moon and the Imperial Citadel
The Xaryxian Empire of astral elves
Astral seeds from the star grow into vines. The vines drain a world and send its energy to the star.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Xaryxis
bodies.summary: A white-hot star, the heart of the Xaryxian Empire. The astral elves use its light for their magic. Its light is dim, so the elves harvest astral seeds from it to drain other worlds.
facts: Its light powers the magic of the astral elves
Its light began to fade 1,000 years ago
Young solar dragons are born in its core
A royal ring of shooting stars thrown into its core destroys it and everything in the system

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Vaerduran
bodies.summary: A rocky, misshapen world that once held life. The astral elves tested their first astral seeds on it and killed its ecosystem. It is now cracked, barren and little more than a cinder.
facts: The first test site of the astral elves for astral seeds

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Rivus
bodies.summary: A rocky sphere with rich platinum deposits that the astral elves mine. The surface looks empty. Umber hulks, purple worms and other creatures that burrow live below it.
facts: Rich platinum deposits that the astral elves mine
Umber hulks, purple worms and other creatures that burrow live underground

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Xaryndar
bodies.summary: A lush, green world full of life. Plants grow to great size in the light of Xaryxis, and many of the most dangerous creatures are intelligent plants. Most elves left long ago, but a small number of settlements remain.
facts: Huge plants, forests and intelligent plant creatures
Most elves left to be closer to their gods on the Astral Plane. Small settlements grow crystal-leaf trees for star moths.

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Eysix
bodies.summary: The one moon of Xaryndar. The book names it in the table of the system and gives no other detail.
facts: The book gives only the name

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

bodies.name: Imperial Citadel
bodies.summary: A city in space on a floating platform of hewn stone, shaped like a moth. It is the seat of the imperial family and it orbits Xaryxis. A beam of light joins its temple crystal to the star.
facts: City in space on a moth-shaped platform of stone
A beam of light 300 million miles long joins the temple crystal to Xaryxis
Twelve linked spelljamming helms move it at about 5.5 miles per hour
It has its own air envelope and gravity plane

sources.title: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Light of Xaryxis

spheres.name: Remichispace
spheres.summary: A large star system in wildspace, named for the planet Remichi. It had a large role in the war against the Xaryxian Empire. It has four planets and an asteroid belt, Basalt's Belt.
facts: One or two stars. The map shows one.
Beloria, Byzunov, Remichi, and one unnamed planet
Basalt's Belt, with the asteroid Omomia, and the asteroid Zar'bos
It had a large role in the war against the Xaryxian Empire
Almost none are large. Most inhabitants stay for a short time or are not sentient.

bodies.name: The star
bodies.summary: The star at the center of Remichispace. Sources say that the system has one or two stars, and this map shows one. Its light on Byzunov is dim.
facts: One or two. The map shows one.
The light of the star is dim on Byzunov. Remichi spends long periods in darkness.

bodies.name: Beloria
bodies.summary: A lush, rocky world about as large as Toril, with a temperate climate. A large spelljamming ship crashed on its surface long ago. Cosmic flares from a nearby system can disable passing ships, and the ships crash on it.
facts: E, about as large as Toril
Temperate, at a comfortable distance from the star
Not given. The map estimates 100 million miles.
A large spelljamming ship crashed here ages ago
Defectors called the Mutineer Underground based themselves here after a crash. Loyal astral elves planted an astral seed here, and it was stopped.

bodies.name: Basalt's Belt
bodies.summary: A belt of rocky basalt asteroids. It formed long ago when two young planets collided and threw cooling magma into wildspace. Omomia is one of its asteroids.
facts: A collision of two young planets
Not given. The map estimates 300 million miles from the star.

bodies.name: Omomia
bodies.summary: An irregular asteroid of dark basalt with pools of water and no air. Astral priests who worship the Plane of Water live on it. Kuo-toa are its natives.
facts: Dark basalt rock and pools of water
Astral priests of the Plane of Water, and native kuo-toa
The goddess Persana gave it its name
In Basalt's Belt. The map estimates 300 million miles from the star.

bodies.name: Byzunov
bodies.summary: A massive, ringed world of carbon, covered with sulfur pools that give off noxious fumes. The star gives it a dim, ominous light. Space orcs and space elves fought on it, then made peace.
facts: Ringed spherical earth body (a carbon planet)
Sulfur pools that give off noxious fumes
The star gives a dim, ominous light
Not given. The map estimates 900 million miles.
Space orcs and space elves fought here, then made peace. Astral elves planted an astral seed here, and it was stopped.

bodies.name: Rings of Byzunov
bodies.summary: Rings around Byzunov. The wiki gives no more information about them.

bodies.name: Unnamed planet
bodies.summary: A planet that the game does not name. Many duergar live on it. They supply the mind flayers of Zar'bos with thralls.
facts: The duergar supply thralls to the mind flayers of Zar'bos
Not given. The map estimates 1.6 billion miles from the star.

bodies.name: Zar'bos
bodies.summary: A tidally locked, dimly lit asteroid with almost no life. A large colony of mind flayers lives on its surface and deep in it, with an unusually large elder brain. A band of githzerai came from Limbo to remove the mind flayers.
facts: A large colony of mind flayers, with an unusually large elder brain
A band of githzerai came from Limbo to remove the mind flayers
Not given. The map uses the orbit of the unnamed planet, 1.6 billion miles from the star.

bodies.name: Remichi
bodies.summary: A dry desert world far from the star, on an orbit of about 200 years. All its water evaporated into space long ago. Ancient beings that gave up their bodies live there.
facts: Far. The map estimates 3.2 billion miles from the 200-year orbit.
Ancient beings that gave up their physical shape. They can stop a spelljamming ship that tries to go away.
The remains of their ancient civilization are on the surface
Mercane landed here in the late 1400s DR. Astral elves tried to demolish the ruins.
